paras: In the Valley of Trials, Hana'zua lies wounded after meeting Sarkoth on the canyon ridges. The Darkspear scout waits for help from young Horde initiates.

Hana'zua lies wounded on the ridges above the Valley of Trials. The Darkspear scout met Sarkoth, a vicious scorpid that stalks the cliffs, and its venomous sting nearly killed him. Unable to move or make his way back to camp, he waits in the dust for passing recruits. He needs them to kill Sarkoth and carry word of his plight to the Den.
